notes: Auto-creates and remembers a private Smart Compressor Telegram channel.
Pins simple usage instructions and best-effort pins the workspace chat.
Processes all new media automatically; LAST_N removed from normal UX.
MODE + GOAL replaced by one PROFILE selector.
Supports explicit reprocessing with reply commands: 🔁, 🔁 أصغر, 🔁 صوت, 🔁 80.
Tracks output lineage/versions to avoid loops and allow re-use.
Sends a batch summary back to Telegram.
Friendly error codes replace large raw tracebacks for normal failures.
